Khmer shaper: Coeng/Ro pref reordering and split-matra handling.

Ports harfrust ot/shaper/khmer.rs (HarfBuzz main, including the linear-time joiner-run guard in the syllable machine). Khmer reorders before any GSUB: dotted circles for broken syllables, Coeng+Ro pref moves with cfar marking, and left-matra moves, then locl/ccmp, the five basic features constrained to syllables, and the four other features after clearing syllables.
